featured_reviews.name: Indira Dutt
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stay outside India, but whenever I visit Mumbai, I make it a point to visit Planet Kids in Mira Road.
Instead of carrying chocolates or cash gifts for the children in my family, I prefer buying toys from here. The happiness on their faces is truly priceless.
Even when I visit friends and relatives, I often pick up toys for their children from Planet Kids. A toy creates memories that last much longer than chocolates and seeing the excitement on a child's face when they open a gift is always special.
They have a wonderful collection of toys, anime figures, Hot Wheels, board games, miniatures, toy cars and so much more. My niece has built quite a collection of anime figures from here, while my nephew is a huge fan of the Hot Wheels collection.
What I enjoy the most is that this shop is not just for children. Every visit takes me down memory lane. I have bought classics like Ludo, Snakes & Ladders and Monopoly for myself, and the fun and nostalgia of playing these games again is something I cannot put into words. For a little while, you forget your age and become a child again! 😊
The quality is good, the prices are reasonable, and the staff have always been helpful and courteous. I am also happy to know that they now have an online ordering option, which makes things even more convenient before travelling to India.
A great place for toys, board games, collectibles and even baby products. Highly recommended for children and for adults who still enjoy keeping a little bit of their childhood alive.
